definitions.explanation: A sum of money ordered for breaking an administrative rule, such as filing a required notice late or smoking on a street where a local ordinance bans it. It is not a criminal penalty and leaves no criminal record.

examples.japanese: {過料|かりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
{路上喫煙|ろじょうきつえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{過料|かりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I was fined for smoking on the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{過料|かりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{科|か}される→科す：30906_kasu⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: If you are late in filing your notice of moving in, you can be given an administrative fine.

notes:
A legal and administrative term, met in news reports, ordinances and official notices. Because ⟦{科料|かりょう}→科料：33284_karyou⟧ has the same reading, people sometimes say あやまちりょう for {過料|かりょう} to keep the two apart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過料|かりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{科|か}す→科す：30906_kasu⟧: to impose an administrative fine
- {過料|かりょう}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: an administrative fine (as a measure)
- {過料|かりょう}⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧: a fine of 1,000 yen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{科料|かりょう}→科料：33284_karyou⟧: minor fine; a criminal penalty under 10,000 yen
- ⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧: fine; a criminal penalty of 10,000 yen or more, and the everyday word for any fine
